consequence.statement: MTU changes on network devices are now detected continuously without requiring agent restart; this improves operational flexibility but represents a change in runtime behavior.

original.statement: MTU auto-detection is now continuous during agent lifetime; changing device MTU no longer requires restarting the agent to pick up the new MTU.

decision.reason: [ev-01a5226ddc9a] says MTU auto-detection now runs continuously for the agent's whole lifetime, so a change to a device's MTU is picked up without restarting the agent. The note doesn't say anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured. It describes runtime behaviour that still works but now behaves differently, so behavior-change (a review-class kind) at low severity fits.
